entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is already taking too long. Just give me a return label.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry for any frustration. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine. It's VF88201. Now hurry up, I don't have all day. If this is going to be a hassle I want to speak to your manager right now.

I'm confident I can resolve this for you. I'm pulling up order VF88201 now... I see the Aero Road Helmet. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
The issue is I hate it! The color is not what it looked like online at all. It's hideous. I never even took it out of the packaging, the box is unopened. This shouldn't be complicated.
I understand. I just need to verify a couple of details against our return policy. One moment please.

Unbelievable. Look, your company's policy better be good. A helmet is a critical piece of safety equipment, and if a customer isn't 100% happy with it for any reason, you should take it back. I will post a review about this on every cycling forum on the internet if you give me any trouble.

I completely agree, your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I've just checked your delivery date and our policy. You received the item 50 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. So... you're just approving it? No fight?

That's correct. There's no issue here at all. I am processing your return right now. I've just emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you. Since the box is unopened, just attach that label and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
Okay. And I get all my money back?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives the helmet. That usually takes about 3-5 business days after they get it.
Huh. Okay, well... that was actually fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
